prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production bitmap background asset for a MapleStory-style game inventory avatar portrait, 420:472 aspect ratio portrait. The input image is a STYLE AND COMPOSITION REFERENCE only. Create the EMPTY background without the character: warm brown wooden wall inside a softly rounded rectangular wooden portrait frame with restrained thin golden edging, chunky dark brown cartoon outlines, tiny muted leaves tucked in the two upper corners, small lively green leaf sprouts at lower left and lower right, tiny stones at ground edges, warmly lit wooden floor in the bottom 20 percent, gentle darker center-back wall vignette. Match the reference polished hand-painted 2D mobile fantasy game UI style. Keep the entire central 65 percent width and central 80 percent height visually calm and free for a separately rendered avatar. A small diffuse empty standing shadow may be placed on the floor center near 82 percent height. There must be NO CHARACTER, NO FACE, NO ITEMS, NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO SYMBOLS, NO BUTTONS. Frame should occupy nearly all image, viewed straight-on, symmetrical rectangular outer shape, exactly one panel. Transparent background outside frame, fully opaque wood and floor inside. Keep leaves within panel bounds, no large intrusive ornaments. This is an actual game sprite, not a mockup.
